name: Thungyai-Huai Kha Khaeng Wildlife Sanctuaries
description: Along Thailand's western border with Myanmar, these two linked sanctuaries cover more than 600,000 hectares of largely untouched forest, one of the biggest protected areas in mainland Southeast Asia. Its habitats range from evergreen to dry forest, sheltering wild elephants and tigers. Together they hold roughly three-quarters of the region's large mammal species.
